children: Optimum, a leading provider of internet, mobile and TV services, today announced that customers in Greenville can upgrade to enhanced internet speeds of up to 2 Gbps – giving residents and businesses greater capacity to stay connected, work, learn and enjoy more online.
As part of its commitment to being more than a connectivity provider, Optimum is also investing
through a technology grant that will support students and help provide access to resources that prepare them for the future.
“Greenville is a great example of what it means to invest in both a community’s connectivity and its future,” said
Jessica Gebhardt, Vice President General Manager, Optimum.

“We’re excited to bring faster speeds to local residents and businesses while also investing directly in students at J.H. Rose High School. We want our customers to know that when we invest in a community, we’re investing in the people who call it home.”

The enhanced speeds are designed to give customers more capacity for today’s growing demands, from streaming and gaming to working from home, connecting multiple devices and supporting small businesses. With download speeds of up to 2 Gig and upload speeds of 100 Mbps, customers can connect more devices and share more content with greater speed and efficiency.

The technology grant to J.H. Rose High School reflects Optimum’s broader commitment to supporting students and organizations across the communities it serves. By helping provide technology resources, Optimum is supporting students as they build the digital skills, knowledge and confidence they need to succeed in an increasingly connected world.

“Investments in reliable connectivity and our students are investments in Greenville’s future,” said P.J. Connelly, Mayor of Greenville. “Faster internet speeds help residents, families and local businesses stay connected and competitive, while support for J.H. Rose High School helps ensure our students have access to the technology and resources they need to succeed. We appreciate Optimum’s continued investment in our community and its commitment to creating opportunities for Greenville residents.”

“Every student deserves access to the tools and technology that help them learn, grow and reach higher,” said Dr. Nydra Jones, principal J. H. Rose High School. “Optimum’s $10,000 technology grant will help us provide students with resources that cultivate learning and prepare them for future success. We’re grateful for Optimum’s investment in our students and their ongoing partnership with J.H. Rose High.”

Optimum continues to invest in the communities it serves through network upgrades, expanded connectivity and partnerships with local schools and community organizations. The company’s community investments are focused on helping residents, students and businesses have the resources they need to thrive.
For more information about Optimum’s services and availability in Greenville, visit optimum.com/internet.
